records.jp: こんな時に言うのはどうかと思うんだけどさ……
records.en_original: I'm not sure if this is the time for this, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not sure if this is the time for this, but...
records.en: I'm not sure if this is the time for this, but...

records.jp: 私……この世界に来れて、よかった
records.en_original: I'm...glad I was able to come to this world.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...glad I was able to come to this world.
records.en: I'm...glad I was able to come to this world.

records.jp: 伶那さん……？
records.en_original: Rena...?
records.en_auxiliary: Rena...?
records.en: Rena-san...?

records.jp: 私、満足してしまってるの
records.en_original: I'm completely satisfied.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm completely satisfied.
records.en: I find myself completely satisfied.

records.jp: 星崎さんと出会えた。みんなと出会えた。<CR>そして何より……勇希と再会できた
records.en_original: I met you, Hoshizaki. I met the others. And most importantly, I was able to see Yuki again.
records.en_auxiliary: I met you, Hoshizaki. I met the others. And most importantly, I was able to see Yuki again.
records.en: I met you, Hoshizaki-san. I met everyone.<CR>And more than anything...I was reunited with Yuki.

records.jp: 私にとっては、それが何より大事。<CR>だから……すごく、幸せなの
records.en_original: That was the most important thing to me. That's why I'm...so happy.
records.en_auxiliary: That was the most important thing to me. That's why I'm...so happy.
records.en: To me, that matters more than anything.<CR>So...I'm very happy.

records.jp: ……伶那さん。押しつけがましいかもしれないけど、<CR>一つ言わせてほしい
records.en_original: Rena... This may not be my place to say, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Rena... This may not be my place to say, but...
records.en: Rena-san... This may sound presumptuous,<CR>but I want to say one thing.

records.jp: こんなんで満足しちゃダメだよ！
records.en_original: You can't be satisfied just with this!
records.en_auxiliary: You can't be satisfied just with this!
records.en: You can't be satisfied just with this!

records.jp: えっ
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: もっと、もっとたくさん、幸せにならないと！！
records.en_original: You can achieve so much more happiness!
records.en_auxiliary: You can achieve so much more happiness!
records.en: You need to become much, much happier!!

records.jp: ほ、星崎さん……？
records.en_original: H-Hoshizaki...?
records.en_auxiliary: H-Hoshizaki...?
records.en: H-Hoshizaki-san...?

records.jp: 再構築された世界なら、<CR>きっと好きなだけ勇希と一緒にいられる
records.en_original: I know you'll be able to spend a lot more time with Yuki in the new world.
records.en_auxiliary: I know you'll be able to spend a lot more time with Yuki in the new world.
records.en: In the rebuilt world,<CR>you can surely spend as much time with Yuki as you want.

records.jp: もっと貪欲にならないと！<CR>勇希のこと、好きなんでしょ？
records.en_original: So don't be satisfied with just this! You like Yuki, don't you?
records.en_auxiliary: So don't be satisfied with just this! You like Yuki, don't you?
records.en: You need to be more greedy!<CR>You love Yuki, don't you?

records.jp: そ、そう、だけど……
records.en_original: W-well, yes...
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, yes...
records.en: W-well, yes...

records.jp: …………そっか。<CR>また私、挑戦することを怖がってたんだ
records.en_original: I see... Perhaps I was afraid.
records.en_auxiliary: I see... Perhaps I was afraid.
records.en: ...I see.<CR>I was afraid to challenge myself again.

records.jp: ……私、一つ目標ができた
records.en_original: I have a new goal now...
records.en_auxiliary: I have a new goal now...
records.en: I've found a goal.

records.jp: 目標？
records.en_original: And that is?
records.en_auxiliary: And that is?
records.en: A goal?

records.jp: 世界が再構築されたら……<CR>私、もっといろんなことに挑戦する
records.en_original: After the world is rebuilt... I'll keep trying new things.
records.en_auxiliary: After the world is rebuilt... I'll keep trying new things.
records.en: When the world is rebuilt...<CR>I'll challenge myself to more things.

records.jp: 私に何ができるかは分からない。<CR>それでも、失敗を恐れずに行動する
records.en_original: I don't know what I'm capable of, but I won't live in fear of failure.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know what I'm capable of, but I won't live in fear of failure.
records.en: I don't know what I'll be able to do.<CR>Even so, I'll act without fearing failure.

records.jp: そして、勇希と出会って……また恋をするんだ
records.en_original: And I'll meet Yuki...and fall in love again.
records.en_auxiliary: And I'll meet Yuki...and fall in love again.
records.en: And I'll meet Yuki...and fall in love again.

records.jp: ……うん。応援してるよ、伶那さん
records.en_original: I'll be cheering for you, Rena.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll be cheering for you, Rena.
records.en: I'll be cheering for you, Rena-san.

records.jp: なんだか、星崎さんには<CR>背中を押されてばっかりな気がしてきた
records.en_original: It's starting to feel like you've been there with me at every step, pushing me along.
records.en_auxiliary: It's starting to feel like you've been there with me at every step, pushing me along.
records.en: I'm starting to feel as though Hoshizaki-san<CR>is always the one giving me a push.

records.jp: そ、そうかな？<CR>私は、そこまで意識してなかったけど……
records.en_original: R-really? I never really thought about it that way...
records.en_auxiliary: R-really? I never really thought about it that way...
records.en: R-really?<CR>I never really thought about it that way...

records.jp: ううん、星崎さんにはたくさんのものをもらったよ
records.en_original: It's true, you've given me so much, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: It's true, you've given me so much, Ao.
records.en: No. You've given me so much, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: きっと、みんなだって同じように思ってるはず
records.en_original: I'm sure the others feel the same way.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure the others feel the same way.
records.en: I'm sure the others feel the same way.

records.jp: 星崎さん。私にとってあなたは特別な人だよ
records.en_original: You are very special to me, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: You are very special to me, Hoshizaki.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, you're someone special to me.

records.jp: ま、もちろん勇希とは違う意味で、だけど
records.en_original: In a different way than Yuki is to me, of course.
records.en_auxiliary: In a different way than Yuki is to me, of course.
records.en: In a different way than Yuki is to me, of course.

records.jp: ……ありがと。そう言われると、<CR>ここに来た意味もあった気がしてくるよ
records.en_original: Thank you... Hearing that makes me feel like it might have been all worth it.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you... Hearing that makes me feel like it might have been all worth it.
records.en: Thank you. Hearing that makes me feel<CR>that coming here had meaning.

records.jp: 何謙遜してんの。もっと自信持ちなって
records.en_original: No need to be modest. You should be proud of yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: No need to be modest. You should be proud of yourself.
records.en: No need to be modest. You should be proud of yourself.

records.jp: あなたがいたから今の私たちがある。<CR>あなたがいなければ、きっとすべて終わってる
records.en_original: I am who I am because of each person here. Without you, all would have been lost.
records.en_auxiliary: I am who I am because of each person here. Without you, all would have been lost.
records.en: We are where we are now because you were here.<CR>Without you, everything would surely be over.

records.jp: ……ありがとう、星崎さん
records.en_original: Thank you...Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you...Hoshizaki.
records.en: ...Thank you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you.
records.en: I want to see you.

records.jp: 星崎さんに会いたい
records.en_original: I miss you, Hoshizaki.
records.en_auxiliary: I miss you, Hoshizaki.
records.en: I want to see you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は、奇跡を信じる
records.en_original: I believe in miracles.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe in miracles.
records.en: I believe in miracles.
